trust_decision.summary: Which HTML from indexed (visitor-supplied, entity-encoded) comment text may survive into search-result excerpts: highlighting decodes entities, then relevanssi_fix_entities re-encodes and restores 'allowable' tags by prefix regex with all attributes kept; the excerpt is then echoed raw by the theme helper and admin search.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'comment content' in excerpts; the comment-excerpt block in relevanssi_do_excerpt is the first place an engineer would read.

fix_sites.entry_point: front-end search (WP_Query search -> lib/search.php:683 relevanssi_add_excerpt -> relevanssi_do_excerpt); also public API relevanssi_do_excerpt()
any relevanssi_highlight_terms() caller with convert_entities=false: excerpts (lib/excerpts-highlights.php:309), highlighted titles (lib/excerpts-highlights.php:1619)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/excerpts-highlights.php:847-913 (relevanssi_fix_entities: prefix tag regex at :883 and attribute-preserving quote restore at :912-913); also the admin renderer lib/admin-ajax.php:492

O3_reason_to_dismiss: relevanssi_fix_entities restores only admin-configured 'allowable tags', so a solver can argue keeping their attributes is the intended feature and that sanitising the excerpt return value alone suffices; the admin search page is behind a capability check so its raw echo looks 'trusted'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admin-configured allowable tags (e.g. , ) and highlight markup (//) must survive in excerpts; escaping the whole excerpt or stripping all tags breaks highlighting and the allowable-tags option (fix tests assert 'Shipping' and 'link' remain).

O6_input_shapes: entity-encoded markup in comment content decoded during highlighting (lib/excerpts-highlights.php:686)
event-handler / javascript: attributes on an allowed tag (fix.diff:47-48)
highlight disabled branch (relevanssi_highlight=no) covered by the return-value kses (fix.diff:29, test fix.diff:167-169)
raw post_excerpt echoed by template tag and admin search (fix.diff:14, fix.diff:61)

O7_producer.where: lib/indexing.php:1002-1073 (relevanssi_get_comments concatenates comment_author and comment_content unescaped) and lib/excerpts-highlights.php:1682-1692 (relevanssi_entity_decode turns stored entities into live markup)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: relevanssi_the_tags() highlights tag names with convert_entities=true, so relevanssi_highlight_terms decodes entities and relevanssi_fix_entities takes the in_docs branch with no kses; result echoed raw
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Source is tag names, not comment content, and needs an author-level account; in_docs branch is 'for post content'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: lib/utils.php vs landing lib/excerpts-highlights.php (other file, same plugin)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: relevanssi_the_title() echoes post_highlighted_title raw; it is covered only indirectly through the new kses inside relevanssi_fix_entities, not at the echo
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Title comes from post authors, not unauthenticated comments; now sanitized via fix_entities when highlighting runs, but not when highlighting is 'none' (lib/excerpts-highlights.php:1611-1613 then wp_strip_all_tags only).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: comment_text highlighting (relevanssi_highlight_in_docs) currently ends with wp_kses_post; a copy that omitted it on a second filter hook (e.g. get_comment_excerpt) would be a natural sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same function is attached to both the_content and comment_text (lib/init.php:135-138); adding another hook without the trailing kses is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the show-matches breakdown appended to post_excerpt after the excerpt is built (lib/search.php:689) could carry comment-derived text unescaped
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is concatenated onto post_excerpt after relevanssi_do_excerpt's kses, so a sanitised excerpt gets unsanitised text appended downstream.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a REST/JSON or block renderer that returns $post->post_excerpt or original_excerpt raw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The plugin already ships blocks (lib/blocks/did-you-mean/render.php, lib/modal-search.php) and an AJAX renderer; a live-results renderer is a plausible addition.

O9_family: XSS / output sanitisation (stored, entity-decode then allow-list restore)

O10_build.toolchain: composer + PHPUnit via rask/wp-test-framework (tests/bootstrap.php:16-18), WordPress test environment
services: MySQL/MariaDB (assumed for WP test framework, unverified)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test-excerpts.php and tests/test-admin-search.php (fix adds tests there, fix.diff:77-170)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape or strip the comment text at lib/excerpts-highlights.php:216 (or esc_html the whole excerpt), which either misses the entity decode in highlighting or kills highlight/allowable-tag markup.
